name: gated-publish
description: Human-gated publish, built from the shipped approve-publish seed: draft -> human approval gate -> branch on the ANSWER -> exactly one arm runs. TEACHES THREE SURFACES: (1) a human `gate` with question+options holds the run until the owner answers with the `release` action — the answer is committed as the gate's output ({answer:...}) and downstream agents read it as DATA via inputs; (2) the branch idiom: two complementary `when` predicates on the answer with the default `on_skip:"prune"` keep EXACTLY ONE arm alive — the pruned arm never spawns and costs zero tokens; (3) model law: no node names a vendor or estate model. Every agent runs on the seat default (the operator's own model config), and the role vocabulary seat-fast (the drafter), seat-strong (the publisher) and judge (the human answering the gate) lives ONLY in goals, contexts and this description — never in a model field. Seed (run_context map, required): 'artifact' = what is being published (e.g. 'report-v3'). The engine refuses launch with a missing seed key — pass {"artifact": "<name>"}. Adapt the publish arm to your real side effect (push a tag, post an announcement, ship a package); the gate and the prune-pair stay verbatim.

nodes.goal: You are the seat-fast drafter. Write a three-line release note for the artifact named in ## Inputs ({run.artifact} when seeded). Reply with ONLY fenced json {"artifact": "<the artifact>", "draft": "<the three lines, one string, lines separated by \n>"}

nodes.question: Publish the drafted release note?
nodes.context: Owner-routed: the judge (the human reading this) answers with the `release` action — answer 'publish' to ship, 'rewrite' to bounce it back to the drafter's owner. The draft is injected above; pressing an option should wake THIS chat, not whichever is open.

nodes.goal: You are the seat-strong publisher. The judge answered the approval gate (## Inputs carries the committed answer). If the answer is not 'publish', something is wrong — reply {"result": "refused", "why": "<one line>"}. Otherwise: record the publication (in production this is where the real side effect goes: tag, push, announce) and reply with ONLY fenced json {"result": "published"}

The judge answered 'rewrite' at the approval gate (## Inputs carries the committed answer and the rejected draft). Reply with ONLY fenced json {"result": "rewrite-requested", "handoff": "<one line telling the owner what to change>"}
